subject: science
passage: The ostrich, the largest living bird, has wings far too small to lift its heavy body off the ground. ______ it is hardly defenseless. Its long, powerful legs allow it to run at speeds of up to about 70 kilometers per hour, fast enough to escape many predators.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

explanation.why: The first sentence states a weakness: the ostrich cannot fly. The next sentence says that, despite this, the bird is "hardly defenseless." The transition must show that the second idea is true in spite of the first.
explanation.A: Incorrect. Being unable to fly would not lead to the bird being well defended; "Therefore" sets up the wrong cause and effect.
explanation.B: Correct. "Still" shows that, although the ostrich cannot fly, it is nevertheless able to protect itself.
explanation.C: Incorrect. Being "hardly defenseless" is not an example of having wings too small to fly.
explanation.D: Incorrect. "Similarly" signals a matching idea, but the second sentence pushes against the first.
